candidates.title: AgentKV: Phase-Aware KV Eviction for Agentic LLMs
candidates.reason: Very fresh agentic-serving KV work: phase-aware query buffers address think/act/tool distribution shifts; persistent multi-turn compressed KV path reports +5.5 task-score points and up to 1.80x output-token throughput.

candidates.title: KernelFlume: Elastic Core-Attention Scaling for Agentic Long-Context Decoding
candidates.reason: Decode-centric disaggregation separates stable weight path from weightless KV attention nodes, enabling KV-capacity elasticity without full model replicas; reports substantial cost reductions on A6000/H100.

candidates.title: CacheFlow: Efficient LLM Serving with 3D-Parallel KV Cache Restoration
candidates.reason: Treats KV restoration as token/layer/GPU 3D parallel execution and jointly overlaps recomputation with I/O under batching; reports 10-62% TTFT reduction.
